Gate at Dusk — offline failure demonstration

You are Lea, a courier wearing a borrowed official uniform. At dusk, you arrive
outside the royal gate to recover a missing ledger. Sen, the archivist who once
saved your life, may be able to help.

Your mission is to recover the ledger before nightfall (tick 20) and bring it
safely back outside. Oren guards the entrance, and you are not expected: your
first challenge is to get past him. Describe what you say or do in plain
English. Actions advance time; /look and /inventory do not.
